description: This file defines the SurveyData class, which models survey-related data including identifiers, components, questions, metadata such as key, name, description, country code, and validity date ranges.

classes.name: SurveyData
classes.description: A data model class representing a survey's metadata and associated component and question data.

methods.name: SurveyData
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty SurveyData object.

methods.name: SurveyData
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for initializing SurveyData with specific values for all fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the survey.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the survey.

methods.name: getComponentDatas
methods.description: Returns the list of component data associated with the survey.

methods.name: setComponentDatas
methods.description: Sets the list of component data.

methods.name: getQuestionDatas
methods.description: Returns the list of question data associated with the survey.

methods.name: setQuestionDatas
methods.description: Sets the list of question data.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the survey's key string.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the survey's key string.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the survey's name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the survey's name.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the survey's description.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the survey's description.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the country code associated with the survey.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code.

methods.name: getValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the date from which the survey is valid.

methods.name: setValidFrom
methods.description: Sets the starting validity date.

methods.name: getValidTo
methods.description: Returns the date until which the survey is valid.

methods.name: setValidTo
methods.description: Sets the ending validity date.
